articles.title: 28 Diaspora Footballers, One Proposal. India's Sports Passport Idea Reaches the PM's Office.
articles.excerpt: The AIFF has identified overseas-born players of Indian origin who could bolster the Blue Tigers — if the government agrees to let them keep their foreign passports.
articles.image_caption: Salt Lake Stadium packed for an Indian Super League opener in Kolkata
articles.nri_angle: Could directly enable NRI athletes in the US, UK, Australia, and Canada to represent India without renouncing their citizenship — the single biggest barrier keeping diaspora talent off Indian national teams.

articles.title: MLC Playoffs Kick Off Wednesday. Unicorns Face Knight Riders as American Cricket's Championship Week Begins.
articles.excerpt: Four weeks of regular season cricket are done. San Francisco, LA, New York, and Washington now battle across Texas and Virginia for the 2026 MLC title.
articles.image_caption: Grand Prairie Stadium in Texas, host venue for MLC 2026 playoff matches
articles.nri_angle: MLC brings world-class T20 cricket to American doorsteps — NRI fans in Texas and the DC metro area can watch playoff cricket live this week, no 3 AM alarms required.

articles.title: Spain Smother France 2-0 in Dallas. La Roja Head to Their First World Cup Final in 16 Years.
articles.excerpt: Oyarzabal's penalty and Porro's cool finish silence Mbappé and end Deschamps' era as Spain book a date at MetLife Stadium on July 19.
articles.image_caption: Pedro Porro celebrates scoring for Spain at the 2026 FIFA World Cup
articles.nri_angle: With the final at MetLife Stadium in the heart of NJ's Indian community, NRI fans have an unprecedented chance to witness a World Cup final on home turf.

articles.title: Patel's All-Round Masterclass Powers India Past England in First ODI. The Big Guns Answer the Call.
articles.excerpt: Axar Patel takes 4-62 and scores 57 as India chase down 259 with ease at Edgbaston, erasing the 4-0 T20I whitewash in one decisive afternoon.
articles.image_caption: Edgbaston Cricket Ground in Birmingham, the venue for the first ODI between England and India
articles.nri_angle: The ODI squad is India's first team with Kohli, Rohit, and Bumrah — NRI fans who suffered through the T20 whitewash can finally breathe again, with Willow TV and JioStar streaming every ball.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Two Titles, One Flag. Gukesh Defends His Crown While Vaishali Chases Hers.
articles.excerpt: For the first time, India has a reigning World Chess Champion and a Women's World Championship challenger in the same year. The 20-year-old from Chennai and the 24-year-old from Mahabalipuram are rewriting the script.
articles.image_caption: D. Gukesh, India's reigning World Chess Champion, will defend his title against Javokhir Sindarov in late 2026
articles.nri_angle: India's chess dominance has fuelled a surge in youth chess enrolment across NRI communities from Silicon Valley to London, with Gukesh and the Rameshbabu siblings as aspirational figures.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: He Codes by Day, Bowls by Night. Netravalkar Takes His Silicon Valley Cricket Story to Oakland's Playoff Stage.
articles.excerpt: The IIT Mumbai graduate and Oracle software engineer has 11 wickets in MLC 2026. Tomorrow, his Washington Freedom face MI New York in the Eliminator — in his Bay Area backyard.
articles.image_caption: The Oakland Coliseum, home to MLC's first-ever West Coast playoffs — and Saurabh Netravalkar's Bay Area backyard
articles.nri_angle: Netravalkar is the quintessential NRI athlete — an IIT graduate and Silicon Valley engineer who became America's cricket hero, now playing MLC playoffs in his Bay Area home turf.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Best Attack Meets Best Defence. France and Spain Collide in Arlington for a Place in the World Cup Final.
articles.excerpt: Mbappé's eight-goal France faces a Spain side that has conceded once all tournament — and hasn't lost in 37 straight. Something has to break.
articles.image_caption: France celebrate reaching a third consecutive World Cup semifinal after beating Morocco 2-0 in the quarterfinal
articles.nri_angle: Indian Americans are among the World Cup's most passionate neutral viewers; Dallas-Fort Worth's massive desi community makes this semifinal a local event as much as a global one.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Kohli, Bumrah, and 50 Overs to Salvage a Tour. India's ODI Campaign Opens at Edgbaston.
articles.excerpt: After a 4-0 T20 whitewash and six consecutive defeats, India's biggest names return for the first ODI in Birmingham — a ground where they have written comebacks before.
articles.image_caption: Edgbaston Cricket Ground in Birmingham, venue for the first ODI between England and India
articles.nri_angle: The UK's two-million-strong Indian diaspora turns Edgbaston into a virtual home ground for India — and after six straight T20 defeats, the community is desperate for a statement win.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Out With Morkel, In With Bahutule. India's Coaching Staff Gets a Post-Whitewash Facelift.
articles.excerpt: Morne Morkel will miss the Sri Lanka tour for personal reasons. Sairaj Bahutule steps in as interim bowling coach. Abhishek Nayar returns. And Gambhir's backroom is starting to look very different from the one that walked into the England disaster.
articles.image_caption: India head coach Gautam Gambhir faces a reshaped coaching staff after the England T20I whitewash
articles.nri_angle: India's coaching instability directly affects whether the team NRIs support can recover its dominance on the world stage.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Manjrekar Says the IPL 'Puts Heavy Makeup' on Indian Batters. Gavaskar Agrees the System Is Broken.
articles.excerpt: After a 4-0 whitewash by England — their worst-ever T20I series defeat — India have lost the world No. 1 ranking. The backlash from legends and experts goes far beyond the dressing room.
articles.image_caption: India T20I captain Shreyas Iyer has six losses in seven matches at the helm after the England whitewash
articles.nri_angle: The IPL — followed religiously by NRIs — is being blamed for India's overseas batting failures, raising uncomfortable questions about the league diaspora fans love.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Six, Four, Four, Six. Hassan Khan's Ten-Ball Demolition Seals the MLC Playoff Picture.

articles.nri_angle: MLC playoffs in Oakland give Bay Area NRIs their first-ever home cricket playoff, with the local SF Unicorns as top seeds — live cricket in the diaspora's backyard.

articles.title: 270 Runs and a Place on the Honours Board. India's Women Make Lord's History.
articles.excerpt: Kranti Gaud becomes the first woman inscribed on Lord's famous honours board, Yastika Bhatia hits a maiden Test century, and Heather Knight retires mid-match as India demolish England in the ground's first-ever women's Test.
articles.image_caption: The Lord's Cricket Ground Pavilion, home to cricket's most famous honours board
articles.nri_angle: India's 270-run demolition at Lord's — led by a 22-year-old pacer and a 24-year-old centurion — changes the conversation for diaspora girls playing cricket in community leagues across the US, UK, and Canada.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Kohli, Rohit, Bumrah Walk In. India's ODI Squad Arrives to Rescue a Tour Gone Wrong.
articles.excerpt: After watching India's young T20I side get whitewashed 4-0, the men who've carried Indian cricket for a decade return for three ODIs starting Tuesday at Edgbaston.
articles.image_caption: Virat Kohli, who returns to the ODI squad for the three-match series in England
articles.nri_angle: NRIs frustrated by the T20I whitewash get the India team they actually want to watch — Kohli, Rohit, and Bumrah — back for three ODIs with early-morning viewing from the US.
